headline: Saudi Non-Oil Revenues Cover 37% of Government Spending, Says Al-Jadaan
summary: Saudi Finance Minister Mohammed Al-Jadaan stated that non-oil revenues now cover approximately 37% of total government spending, up from 16% previously.
why: Diversification away from oil dependence reduces fiscal vulnerability to crude price fluctuations in major petroleum-exporting nations.

impacts.name: Saudi Arabia
impacts.why: Fiscal structure updates demonstrate economic diversification progress.
